sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "TV_series"."Channel" AS e, AVG((CAST(("TV_series"."Share" - "TV_series"."Rating") AS REAL) / "TV_series"."Rating")) AS m1 FROM "TV_series" GROUP BY "TV_series"."Channel"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: TV_series.relative difference of household audience share from household rating
why: (household audience share - household rating) / household rating: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of household audience share from household rating per TV_Channel (by Channel)
index against the all average of average of relative difference of household audience share from household rating (all level)
